QuestInfo.name: Hunting Lessons 1
QuestInfo.0: Moonbeam says that since you can command the spirits, you have a lot more to learn. What's the rush, though? Talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: Moonbeam says you should learn how to hunt. She wants you to start with the easiest prey, the #o2400200#s, and get some #t4009219#s. They look easy to hunt, but you don't like how she keeps referring to them as delicious.
QuestInfo.2: You hunted some #o2400200#s, but you're not sure why. Surely you're not going to eat this...

0.0: Now that you have a spirit, you must be able to hunt for yourself. Hunting should be easy as long as you do exactly what I told you!
0.1: Don't worry, it's easy. We all learn to hunt by ourselves. Failure just means starvation!
0.2: Just kidding. Kinda. I know you're still really weak, so I'll feed you even if you fail. But keep in mind that real foxes must know how to hunt. Let's get started!

yes.0: It's your first hunt, so I'll go easy on you. #o2400200#s will be easy enough prey for you. They're what the smallest kits learn to hunt first. Get me #r10 #t4009219#s#k. And don't think you can get out of this! I'll be watching.

no.0: A fox has to know how to get their own food. No freeloading! Get hunting!

1.0: How goes the hunt? I hope you didn't come back empty-handed!

default.0: You can't call yourself a Pointy-Ear Fox if you can't even hunt stupid caterpillars!
